messages.text:
Yes, we can combine them, and I've created a new proposal for both items.

- **Why the decanter proposal expired:** A proposal can only be confirmed, approved or paid within 72 hours of being created. The decanter proposal (h414-p2) wasn't paid in that time, so it lapsed and a new one was needed (refund-policy/v2/validity).
- **The glasses proposal:** A staff member rejected h414-p1. No reason is recorded on it. The new proposal needs your confirmation and a staff member's approval again (refund-policy/v2/approval).
- **Time limit:** Your refund deadline is 2026-11-25 10:00 UTC. You're still within it, and both items are recorded as received back (refund-policy/v2/window, refund-policy/v2/return).

**New proposal:** Quartet wine glasses (26.90) plus Crystal decanter (79.90) comes to **106.80 BRL** (refund-policy/v2/amount).

Please confirm it with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count. After you confirm, a staff member will review it.
